title: STEW common definitions
description: Definitions shared by every STEW kind. Draft 2026-11-08.

version.description: A STEW specification version: a date, with an optional -draft suffix.

name.description: A lowercase identifier: letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.

toolName.description: A tool name exactly as the runtime's tool catalog (for example an MCP server's tools/list) names it.

profileRef.description: A profile named by name, or by name@version to pin one version.

id.description: An identifier unique within its board or ledger.

relativePath.description: A host-neutral path relative to the board's root: forward slashes, no drive letter, no leading slash, no '..' segment, no home directory.

timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 date-time with a UTC offset.

header.description: The two members every declaration starts with.

taskState.description: The task lifecycle (spec/lifecycle.md). submitted, working, input-required, completed, failed, canceled and rejected are A2A TaskState names; claimed, reported and unloaded are STEW's.

bindingRef.description: What a result was measured on: the binding's name, model and hardware.
